# Velair 1.9.2

This patch release adds climate-name display options and fixes repeated Room Assist commands and stale saved settings.

## ✨ Added

- Choose how climate names appear in **Settings**: keep current names (the default), add separate area context for repeated names, or use entity names with context. Custom card and Room group names retain priority. The preference is saved across Velair and included when exporting and importing Settings. Thanks to @overas for reporting [#87](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/87).
- Translated the new naming controls and usage guidance into all nine supported non-English languages.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- Prevent Room Assist from repeatedly sending an unchanged target when a temperature reading changes while its final command is being accepted. Subsequent corrections and existing delivery recovery remain active. Thanks to @sankukace for reporting [#86](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/86).
- Keep Supply control switches and configuration revisions synchronized after saving, avoiding false conflicts on subsequent saves. Manual suspension and resume also show the latest saved state in connected panels.
- Keep external execution selections consistent while saving. Failed or cancelled saves preserve the previous selection, while successful saves show confirmed ownership without waiting for a slow provider. Other thermostats continue their local schedules.

## 🧭 Notes

- Existing climate names stay unchanged unless you select another display option. The display preference does not rename Home Assistant entities or change their IDs, schedules or climate commands.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app to load the updated frontend.
- Translated guides remain synchronized with their English sources and await human linguistic review.
